info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: API for Reports and Dashboards in Zoho Analytics - covering the creation, update and metadata retrieval of analysis views, and the listing, creation, metadata retrieval and update of dashboards.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description:
APIs for creating, updating and reading the metadata of analysis views (charts, pivot tables and summary views) inside a workspace.

An analysis view is always built on top of a base table in the same workspace. Its whole definition - report type, chart sub-type, axis columns, filters, user filters, drill actions and display settings - travels in a single `CONFIG` JSON parameter that is shared, field for field, by all three APIs in this module.

## Common request conventions

| Header | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | `Zoho-oauthtoken <oauth-token>` | Mandatory |
| `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` | Organization ID owning the workspace | Mandatory |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` | POST and PUT only |

For Create and Update, `CONFIG` is a URL encoded JSON string sent as a form field named `CONFIG`. Get Report Metadata takes no `CONFIG` at all - every input is a URL path parameter.

A `workspaceKey` in the format `orgid/workspacename` may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

`CONFIG` has a maximum serialized size of 10 MB for both Create and Update. The nested arrays `axisColumns`, `mergeAxisInfo`, `filters` and `userFilters` are the ones that realistically approach it.

## OAuth scopes

| API | Method | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Create Analysis View | POST | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create` |
| Update Analysis View | PUT | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.update` |
| Get Report Metadata | GET | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.read` |

## Response envelope

Every response follows the standard Zoho Analytics V2 envelope.

**Update Analysis View returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success** - there is no JSON body to parse. Create Analysis View and Get Report Metadata return the envelope below; every API returns it on failure.

- **status** - `success` or `failure`. Present in the JSON success responses of Create Analysis View and Get Report Metadata, and in every failure response.
- **summary** - human readable message describing the result. Present only in the JSON success responses of Create Analysis View and Get Report Metadata.
- **data.viewId** - Create only. The ID of the newly created analysis view; use it in the URL of later Update and Get Report Metadata calls.
- **data.reportConfig** - Get Report Metadata only. The full stored configuration of the view.
- **errorCode** and **errorMessage** - failure only.

## Update is a reset, not a patch

Update Analysis View replaces the whole configuration. Every axis column, filter, user filter and settings entry is overwritten with what was sent, fields that are omitted revert to their empty defaults, and `description` is cleared if it is left out. Always fetch, modify, then write back the complete configuration.

**Read-modify-write**

1. `GET /restapi/v2/workspaces/{workspace-id}/reports/{view-id}/metadata` and take `data.reportConfig`.
2. Change only what needs to change - for example `chartType` from `bar` to `line`, or appending one entry to `axisColumns`. Carry the full `axisColumns`, `filters` and `userFilters` arrays through; anything dropped here is permanently removed from the view.
3. `PUT` the complete modified object back as `CONFIG`.

**Cloning a view**

`data.reportConfig` is structurally identical to the Create `CONFIG`, so it doubles as a clone template. Give the clone a `title` that is unique in the workspace, keep `baseTableName`, and add `folderId` only if the copy belongs somewhere other than the default folder. When cloning across workspaces, every `columnName` and `tableName` in `axisColumns` must exist in the target workspace's base table.

## Fields that behave unexpectedly on Update

| Field | Behaviour | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | Silently ignored; the existing display name is always preserved. There is no V2 field to rename a view through Update. | Send it for clarity if you like, knowing it does nothing. |
| `reportType` | Cannot be changed. A value that does not match the existing view type fails with error 8021. | Carry it unchanged from the Get Report Metadata response. |
| `folderId` | If it differs from the view's current folder the request fails. The same value is a harmless no-op. | Omit it. It is not returned by Get Report Metadata, so it is naturally absent when the response is used as the base. |
| `description` | Read from the CONFIG on every write. If absent it is set to null, clearing it. | Copy it from the Get Report Metadata response. |
| `baseTableName` | Derived from the view's stored parent reference, not from the CONFIG. | Harmless to include; it has no effect. |
| `axisColumns`, `filters`, `userFilters` | Fully replaced. Omitting them removes everything. | Send the full arrays unless the intent is to clear them. |
| `mergeAxisInfo` | Required whenever `isAxisMerge` is true. | Omit both when axis merge is off. |

## Axis type casing

The request samples use camelCase (`xAxis`, `yAxis`, `colorAxis`) while Get Report Metadata returns lowercase (`xaxis`, `yaxis`, `coloraxis`, `sizeaxis`, `textaxis`, `groupby`, `summarize`). The lowercase forms are documented as canonical. When building a `CONFIG` from a metadata response, copy the `type` values verbatim rather than re-casing them.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description:
APIs for listing dashboards accessible to a user, and for creating, reading and updating dashboards inside a workspace.

The module splits into two families that behave differently.

- **Listing APIs** - Get All Dashboards, Get Owned Dashboards and Get Shared Dashboards. These operate at user service level and return dashboards across every organization the caller belongs to. No `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header is needed, and the OAuth token must be issued with user level scope.
- **Workspace-scoped APIs** - Create Dashboard, Get Dashboard Metadata and Update Dashboard. These operate on one workspace and require the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header.

## Common request conventions

| Header | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | `Zoho-oauthtoken <oauth-token>` | Mandatory for every API |
| `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` | Organization ID owning the workspace | Workspace-scoped APIs only |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` | Create and Update only |

Get Shared Dashboards works on custom domains. Get All Dashboards and Get Owned Dashboards are disabled on custom domains. The workspace-scoped APIs are reachable on custom domains subject to additional permission checks.

## OAuth scopes

| API | Method | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Get All Dashboards | GET | `ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read` |
| Get Owned Dashboards | GET | `ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read` |
| Get Shared Dashboards | GET | `ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read` |
| Create Dashboard | POST | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create` |
| Get Dashboard Metadata | GET | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.read` |
| Update Dashboard | PUT | `ZohoAnalytics.modeling.update` |

## Response envelope

- **status** - `success` or `failure`.
- **summary** - human readable description of the completed operation.
- **data.ownedViews** and **data.sharedViews** - Get All Dashboards only.
- **data.views** - Get Owned Dashboards and Get Shared Dashboards; a single list, owned-only or shared-only depending on the endpoint.
- **data.dashboardId** and **data.displayName** - Create Dashboard only.
- **data.dashboardConfig** - Get Dashboard Metadata only.

`viewId`, `workspaceId` and `orgId` are returned as strings even though the underlying values are long integers. `createdTime` and `lastModifiedTime` are epoch timestamps in milliseconds, as strings - divide by 1000 for epoch seconds. `sharedBy` is present on every entry, empty in owned items and populated with an email in shared ones. `isFavorite` is user specific and reflects the requesting user.

`dashboardConfig.objId`, `data.dashboardId` and `viewId` are the same value under three different names.

## Update replaces sections wholesale

Update Dashboard does not merge. When `layout`, `themes` or `settings` is included, every stored row for that section is deleted and exactly what was sent is stored in its place. Sending `{"settings":{"enableGlobalUF":"true"}}` reverts every other setting to its system default. A section left out of the CONFIG is not touched.

**Read-modify-write**

1. `GET .../metadata?CONFIG={"include":"settings"}` to fetch just the section being changed.
2. Merge the change into the returned object, keeping every key that came back.
3. `PUT` the complete section.

**Adding a layout card without losing the others**

The layout is a complete card map keyed by index string. Fetch it with `include=layout`, append the new card under the next sequential key, and PUT the whole map back.

**Cloning a dashboard**

Fetch the full metadata, take `layout`, `themes` and `settings` from `dashboardConfig`, drop `objId`, `displayName` and `description` (they are read-only in the response and are not valid Create CONFIG fields other than `displayName`/`description`, which must be supplied fresh), then POST with a new `displayName`. The `viewName` values inside `layout` must match views that exist in the target workspace.

## Behaviour worth knowing before the first call

| Case | Behaviour | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| Partial `settings` on Update | Only the keys sent are stored; the rest revert to defaults. | Send the full settings object fetched via GET. |
| Section omitted on Update | Left unchanged. | Include only the sections being replaced. |
| `layoutType` grid preset (1-4) | The server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at index `"1"` and rearranges view cards into columns, renumbering the input. | Omit `layoutType`, or send 0, for free form layouts; confirm with a GET afterwards. |
| `viewName` in a layout card | Identifies an analysis view by display name, not ID. A renamed or deleted view renders as a broken card. | Verify view names through the Reports APIs first. |
| Resetting the theme | `{"themes":{"default":"true"}}` clears all theme customization in one call. | Use it to undo theme changes without knowing the original values. |
| Tabbed dashboards | Get Dashboard Metadata and Update Dashboard fail with error 8102. | Check the dashboard type first. |
| `include` with several sections | `include=themes,layout` returns both sections but omits `objId`, `displayName` and `description`. | Use `include=all` when identity fields are needed, such as for clone workflows. |
| Scalar types in the response | Theme and settings scalars come back as strings even where the CONFIG accepts numbers. | Coerce before comparing, and send back the form the CONFIG documents. |

post.description:
Creates a new analysis view - a chart, a pivot table or a summary view - in the specified workspace, based on a referenced base table. The view is configured through the CONFIG JSON parameter, which specifies the report type, the axis columns, the filters and the visualization settings.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or a Workspace Admin, or a Shared User, or a Group Member, or any user with Create Report permission on the workspace.

Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
The CONFIG parameter must be sent as a URL encoded JSON string in a form field named CONFIG, with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

2.value:
Note:

3.value:

The Create and Update samples use camelCase (xAxis, yAxis, colorAxis), while Get Report Metadata returns the lowercase forms (xaxis, yaxis, coloraxis, sizeaxis, textaxis, groupby, summarize), which the documentation states are the canonical values. When building a Create or Update CONFIG from a Get Report Metadata response, copy the axis type values verbatim.

4.value:

put.description:
Resets and updates the configuration of an existing analysis view in the specified workspace. The whole view configuration - axis columns, filters, user filters, chart type and settings - is replaced with the values provided in the CONFIG parameter, so anything that is omitted reverts to its empty default. Fetch the current configuration with Get Report Metadata, modify it, and send the complete object back.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or the View Owner, or a Shared User, or a Group Member, or any user with Design Modify permission on the view.

1.value:
Note:
Update Analysis View performs a full configuration reset, not a patch.
  • Every axis column, filter, user filter and settings entry is replaced with the values sent in the CONFIG.
  • Fields that are not provided revert to their empty defaults - omitting axisColumns, filters or userFilters clears them.
  • description is cleared if it is omitted.
  • Always fetch the current state with Get Report Metadata, modify it, then send the complete configuration back.

Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
The CONFIG parameter must be sent as a URL encoded JSON string in a form field named CONFIG, with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

2.value:
Note:
The following fields cannot be changed through Update Analysis View:
  • title - silently ignored; the existing display name is always preserved.
  • folderId - the request fails if the value differs from the view's current folder. Omit it entirely.
  • reportType - must match the existing view type. A mismatch fails with error code 8021.
  • baseTableName - derived from the view's stored parent reference. Sending it is harmless but has no effect.

3.value:
Note:
chartType, isAxisMerge and mergeAxisInfo apply only when reportType is chart. chartType is required for chart views, and mergeAxisInfo must be supplied whenever isAxisMerge is true.

The Create and Update samples use camelCase (xAxis, yAxis, colorAxis), while Get Report Metadata returns the lowercase forms (xaxis, yaxis, coloraxis, sizeaxis, textaxis, groupby, summarize), which the documentation states are the canonical values. When building a Create or Update CONFIG from a Get Report Metadata response, copy the axis type values verbatim.

5.value:
Note:

get.description:
Retrieves the full configuration metadata of an existing analysis view - a chart, a pivot table or a summary view - in the specified workspace. The response carries the report type, the chart sub-type, the axis column definitions, the applied filters and the visualization settings exactly as they are stored.

The returned `reportConfig` is structurally identical to the Create Analysis View CONFIG, which makes this API the first step of any safe update or clone workflow.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or the View Owner, or any user with Design Modify permission on the view.

Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
Axis type casing differs between request and response. The Create and Update samples use camelCase (xAxis, yAxis, colorAxis), while Get Report Metadata returns the lowercase forms (xaxis, yaxis, coloraxis, sizeaxis, textaxis, groupby, summarize), which the documentation states are the canonical values. When building a Create or Update CONFIG from a Get Report Metadata response, copy the axis type values verbatim.

2.value:
Note:
Update Analysis View performs a full configuration reset, not a patch.
  • Every axis column, filter, user filter and settings entry is replaced with the values sent in the CONFIG.
  • Fields that are not provided revert to their empty defaults - omitting axisColumns, filters or userFilters clears them.
  • description is cleared if it is omitted.
  • Always fetch the current state with Get Report Metadata, modify it, then send the complete configuration back.

3.value:
Note:

Change title to a value that is unique in the workspace, keep baseTableName, and verify that every columnName and tableName exists in the target workspace's base table before posting.

get.description:
Returns all dashboards accessible to the authenticated user - both those owned by the user and those shared with them - across every organization and workspace. The response groups the results into two separate lists, `ownedViews` and `sharedViews`.

This API has no request parameters; all context is derived from the OAuth token. The authenticated user may be any active Zoho Analytics user.

1.value:
Note:
This is a user service level API - it returns dashboards across every organization the caller belongs to.
  • The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is not required.
  • The OAuth token must be issued with user level scope.

2.value:
Note:
Get Shared Dashboards is available on custom domains. Get All Dashboards and Get Owned Dashboards are disabled on custom domains. The workspace-scoped dashboard APIs are accessible on custom domains subject to additional permission checks.

200.description: The list of dashboards was retrieved successfully.

ownedAndShared.summary: The user owns two dashboards and has one more shared with them.

ownedViews.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

ownedOnly.summary: The user owns one dashboard and nothing has been shared with them, so sharedViews comes back empty.

ownedViews.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

noDashboards.summary: The user has no dashboards at all and both lists come back empty.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: User does not have permission to retrieve dashboards.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Ensure the request uses a valid OAuth token for an active Zoho Analytics user.
Provide a valid, non-expired OAuth token in the Authorization header.

post.description:
Creates a new dashboard in the specified workspace. The dashboard is defined through the CONFIG JSON parameter, which carries the display name, the layout card map and, optionally, the visual theme and the behaviour settings.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or a Workspace Admin, or a Shared User, or a Group Member, or any user with Create Report permission on the workspace.

1.value:
Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
The CONFIG parameter must be sent as a URL encoded JSON string in a form field named CONFIG, with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

2.value:
Note:
A VIEW card identifies an analysis view by its display name in viewName, not by its ID. If the referenced view is renamed or deleted the card renders as broken, and when cloning across workspaces the viewName values must be updated to match views that exist in the target workspace.

3.value:
Note:
When layoutType is set to a grid preset (1 to 4), the server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at position "1" and rearranges the view cards into columns, so the card indices that were sent may be renumbered. Omit layoutType, or set it to 0, for a free form layout, and call Get Dashboard Metadata afterwards to confirm the layout that was actually stored.

1.value:
Note:
dashboardConfig.objId in the metadata response, data.dashboardId in the Create Dashboard response and viewId in the listing APIs are the same value under three different field names. Any of them can be used as the dashboard ID in the URL path.

get.description:
Retrieves the stored configuration of a dashboard in the specified workspace - its identity attributes, the visual theme, the layout card map and the behaviour settings. The optional CONFIG parameter narrows the response to specific sections.

This is the first step of any safe update: fetch the section to be changed, merge the change into it, then send the complete section back through Update Dashboard.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or the View Owner, or any user with Read Only permission on the dashboard.

1.value:
Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
The include attribute controls which sections are returned.
  • all, or omitting CONFIG altogether, returns objId, displayName, description, themes, layout and settings.
  • A specific section such as themes returns only that section, without the objId, displayName and description identity fields.
  • Several sections can be requested as a comma separated list, for example themes,layout.

2.value:
Note:
As this is a GET request, the CONFIG value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

1.value:
Note:
The metadata response serializes theme and settings scalars as strings even where the CONFIG accepts numbers - for example a layoutType sent as 6 is returned as "6", and a card opacity sent as 0.2 is returned as "0.2". Only the layout card geometry (width, height, left, top) is returned as numbers. Sections that were never customized are omitted from the response entirely.

2.value:
Note:
dashboardConfig.objId in the metadata response, data.dashboardId in the Create Dashboard response and viewId in the listing APIs are the same value under three different field names. Any of them can be used as the dashboard ID in the URL path.

3.value:
Note:
Update Dashboard replaces a whole section rather than merging into it. When layout, themes or settings is included, every stored row for that section is deleted and exactly what was sent is stored.
  • Sending only some settings keys reverts all other settings to their system defaults.
  • A section that is absent from the CONFIG is left unchanged, so it is safe to omit sections that are not being modified.
  • Fetch the section with Get Dashboard Metadata, merge the change into it, then send the complete section back.

put.description:
Updates an existing dashboard in the specified workspace. Every attribute of the CONFIG is optional and a section that is left out is not touched, but a section that is sent replaces the stored one wholesale rather than merging into it. Fetch the section with Get Dashboard Metadata, merge the change into it, then send the complete section back.

`displayName` and `description` are not part of this CONFIG - a dedicated rename API is needed to change the dashboard name.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin, or the View Owner, or any user with Design Modify permission on the dashboard.

1.value:
Note:
Update Dashboard replaces a whole section rather than merging into it. When layout, themes or settings is included, every stored row for that section is deleted and exactly what was sent is stored.
  • Sending only some settings keys reverts all other settings to their system defaults.
  • A section that is absent from the CONFIG is left unchanged, so it is safe to omit sections that are not being modified.
  • Fetch the section with Get Dashboard Metadata, merge the change into it, then send the complete section back.

Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.

Note:
The CONFIG parameter must be sent as a URL encoded JSON string in a form field named CONFIG, with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

2.value:
Note:
A VIEW card identifies an analysis view by its display name in viewName, not by its ID. If the referenced view is renamed or deleted the card renders as broken, and when cloning across workspaces the viewName values must be updated to match views that exist in the target workspace.

3.value:
Note:
When layoutType is set to a grid preset (1 to 4), the server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at position "1" and rearranges the view cards into columns, so the card indices that were sent may be renumbered. Omit layoutType, or set it to 0, for a free form layout, and call Get Dashboard Metadata afterwards to confirm the layout that was actually stored.

x-zenesis-shared-notes.description: Canonical text of the notes that apply to more than one API in this module, distilled from the Appendices of the Reports and Dashboards help pages. Each operation carries a materialised copy of the relevant entries inside its x-zenesis-sections, tagged with x-zenesis-shared-note naming the key it came from. Edit a note here first, then propagate it to the operations that reference it.

notes.axisTypeCasing:
Note:
Axis type casing differs between request and response. The Create and Update samples use camelCase (xAxis, yAxis, colorAxis), while Get Report Metadata returns the lowercase forms (xaxis, yaxis, coloraxis, sizeaxis, textaxis, groupby, summarize), which the documentation states are the canonical values. When building a Create or Update CONFIG from a Get Report Metadata response, copy the axis type values verbatim.
notes.chartOnlyAttributes:
Note:
chartType, isAxisMerge and mergeAxisInfo apply only when reportType is chart. chartType is required for chart views, and mergeAxisInfo must be supplied whenever isAxisMerge is true.
notes.configGetUrlEncoded:
Note:
As this is a GET request, the CONFIG value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.
notes.configSizeLimit:
Note:
The CONFIG parameter has a maximum serialized size of 10 MB. Ensure that the nested arrays - axisColumns, mergeAxisInfo, filters and userFilters - do not push the total CONFIG payload beyond this limit.
notes.configUrlEncoded:
Note:
The CONFIG parameter must be sent as a URL encoded JSON string in a form field named CONFIG, with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
notes.dashboardCustomDomain:
Note:
Get Shared Dashboards is available on custom domains. Get All Dashboards and Get Owned Dashboards are disabled on custom domains. The workspace-scoped dashboard APIs are accessible on custom domains subject to additional permission checks.
notes.dashboardIdEquivalence:
Note:
dashboardConfig.objId in the metadata response, data.dashboardId in the Create Dashboard response and viewId in the listing APIs are the same value under three different field names. Any of them can be used as the dashboard ID in the URL path.
notes.dashboardIncludeSemantics:
Note:
The include attribute controls which sections are returned.
  • all, or omitting CONFIG altogether, returns objId, displayName, description, themes, layout and settings.
  • A specific section such as themes returns only that section, without the objId, displayName and description identity fields.
  • Several sections can be requested as a comma separated list, for example themes,layout.
notes.dashboardLayoutTypePreset:

When layoutType is set to a grid preset (1 to 4), the server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at position "1" and rearranges the view cards into columns, so the card indices that were sent may be renumbered. Omit layoutType, or set it to 0, for a free form layout, and call Get Dashboard Metadata afterwards to confirm the layout that was actually stored.

Note:
Update Dashboard replaces a whole section rather than merging into it. When layout, themes or settings is included, every stored row for that section is deleted and exactly what was sent is stored.
  • Sending only some settings keys reverts all other settings to their system defaults.
  • A section that is absent from the CONFIG is left unchanged, so it is safe to omit sections that are not being modified.
  • Fetch the section with Get Dashboard Metadata, merge the change into it, then send the complete section back.

Only the layout card geometry (width, height, left, top) is returned as numbers. Sections that were never customized are omitted from the response entirely.
notes.dashboardTabbedUnsupported:
Note:
Tabbed dashboards are not supported by the V2 API. Calling this API on a tabbed dashboard fails with error code 8102.
notes.dashboardViewNameByName:
Note:
A VIEW card identifies an analysis view by its display name in viewName, not by its ID. If the referenced view is renamed or deleted the card renders as broken, and when cloning across workspaces the viewName values must be updated to match views that exist in the target workspace.
notes.orgIdHeader:
Note:
This is a workspace-scoped API. The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory. A workspaceKey in the format orgid/workspacename (for example, 700000123456/Sales_Analytics) may be used in place of the numeric workspace ID in the URL path.
notes.reportCloneWorkflow:
Note:
The reportConfig object returned by Get Report Metadata is structurally identical to the Create CONFIG, so it can be used directly as a clone template. Change title to a value that is unique in the workspace, keep baseTableName, and verify that every columnName and tableName exists in the target workspace's base table before posting.
notes.reportFullReset:
Note:
Update Analysis View performs a full configuration reset, not a patch.
  • Every axis column, filter, user filter and settings entry is replaced with the values sent in the CONFIG.
  • Fields that are not provided revert to their empty defaults - omitting axisColumns, filters or userFilters clears them.
  • description is cleared if it is omitted.
  • Always fetch the current state with Get Report Metadata, modify it, then send the complete configuration back.
notes.reportReadOnlyFields:
Note:
The following fields cannot be changed through Update Analysis View:
  • title - silently ignored; the existing display name is always preserved.
  • folderId - the request fails if the value differs from the view's current folder. Omit it entirely.
  • reportType - must match the existing view type. A mismatch fails with error code 8021.
  • baseTableName - derived from the view's stored parent reference. Sending it is harmless but has no effect.
notes.updateNoResponseBody:
Note:
This API returns no response body on success - only an HTTP 204 No Content status. There is no JSON payload to parse; check the HTTP status code alone. Only failure responses carry a JSON error payload.
notes.userScopeListing:
Note:
This is a user service level API - it returns dashboards across every organization the caller belongs to.
  • The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is not required.
  • The OAuth token must be issued with user level scope.

AxisColumn.title: AxisColumn
AxisColumn.description: Defines one dimension or measure placed on the analysis view.

type.description: Axis role this column plays in the view.

columnName.description: Name of the column. Mandatory unless `columnId` is provided.

columnId.description: ID of the column, as an alternative to `columnName`.

tableName.description: Table the column belongs to. Useful in multi-table workspaces.

tableId.description: ID of the table, as an alternative to `tableName`.

displayName.description: Custom label shown on the axis in the rendered view.

operation.description: Aggregation or date grouping applied to the column.

geoRole.description: Geographic role of the column. Mandatory when `operation` is geo.

rangeSize.description: Bucket size used for numeric range grouping, applied with the range operation.

sort.description: Sort direction applied to this axis dimension.

AxisColumns.title: AxisColumns
AxisColumns.description: JSONArray defining the axis, dimension and measure configuration of the view. Maximum serialized size 1 MB.

ColumnFormat.title: ColumnFormat
ColumnFormat.description: JSONObject controlling how the values of an axis column are rendered.

type.description: Format category applied to the column values.

currencyFormat.description: Currency symbol or code shown alongside the value.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the value within the cell.

thousandSeparator.description: Controls whether a thousand separator is inserted.

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places to display.

decimalSeparator.description: Character used as the decimal separator.

showSymbol.description: Controls whether the currency or percentage symbol is shown.

showNegativeSign.description: Controls whether an explicit minus sign is shown for negative values.

numberingType.description: Scale suffix applied to large numbers.

unitsList.description: Custom unit suffix appended to the value.

displayLabel.description: Label override displayed in the chart legend.

dateFormat.description: Pattern used to display date values.

userLocale.description: Controls whether the viewer's locale is applied when formatting the value.

WindowFunction.title: WindowFunction
WindowFunction.description: JSONObject applying a table calculation on top of the aggregated value of a measure.

type.description:
Window function applied to the measure.

- **runTotal** - Running total accumulated across the axis.
- **pctOfTotal** - Percentage of the grand total.
- **pctOfCol** - Percentage of the column total.
- **pctdifffrom** - Percentage difference from the reference field.
- **movingAvg** - Moving average over the window defined in `movingCalculation`.

baseField.description: Name of the reference column used by the comparison functions.

baseTable.description: Name of the table the reference column belongs to.

baseFieldPosition.description: Axis position occupied by the reference field.

baseFunction.description: Date grouping operation applied to the reference field.

percentileVal.description: Target percentile, applicable only with the percentile operation.

MovingCalculation.title: MovingCalculation
MovingCalculation.description: JSONObject defining the moving window used by the movingAvg window function.

calculation.description: Aggregation evaluated over the moving window.

previous.description: Number of preceding data points included in the window.

next.description: Number of following data points included in the window.

includeCurrent.description: Controls whether the current data point is part of the window.

includeNull.description: Controls whether null values are counted within the window.

MergeAxisInfo.title: MergeAxisInfo
MergeAxisInfo.description: JSONArray listing the y-axis groupings applied when `isAxisMerge` is true. Maximum serialized size 10 MB.

MergeAxisGroup.title: MergeAxisGroup
MergeAxisGroup.description: One group of y-axes merged onto a single scale.

axisIndex.description: One-based positions of the axis columns that share the merged scale.

items.description: One-based position of an axis column in `axisColumns`.

labelName.description: Label displayed against the merged axis.

ReportFilters.title: ReportFilters
ReportFilters.description: JSONArray of data filters applied to the view at render time. Maximum serialized size 1 MB.

ReportFilter.title: ReportFilter
ReportFilter.description: Restricts the data rendered in the view based on the values of one column.

columnName.description: Name of the column the filter operates on.

columnId.description: ID of the column, as an alternative to `columnName`.

tableName.description: Name of the table the column belongs to.

tableId.description: ID of the table, as an alternative to `tableName`.

operation.description: How the column value is computed before the filter is evaluated.

filterType.description:
Category of filter applied to the column.

- **value** - Matches the exact values listed in `values`.
- **ranking** - Top or bottom N, expressed as a string such as `Top 5` in `values`.
- **wildcard** - Pattern match driven by the `wildcard` attribute.
- **individualValues** - Discrete value picker used by interactive user filters.
- **year**, **quarter**, **month**, **week**, **weekday** - Date part groupings.
- **fulldate**, **date**, **datetime** - Absolute date or date-time matching.
- **quarteryear**, **weekyear** - Combined date part groupings.
- **common** - Relative period such as a rolling window.
- **range** - Bounded range between two values.

rankingColumn.description: Column used to rank the results when `filterType` is ranking.

rankingColumnDateSubType.description: Date sub-grouping applied to the ranking reference column.

exclude.description: Controls whether the listed values are excluded instead of included.

FilterValues.title: FilterValues
FilterValues.description: JSONArray of the values the filter matches on, or the ranking specification when `filterType` is ranking.

FilterWildcard.title: FilterWildcard
FilterWildcard.description: JSONObject describing a wildcard filter, applied when `filterType` is wildcard.

expression.description: Logical expression combining the criteria by their one-based position.

WildcardCriteria.title: WildcardCriteria
WildcardCriteria.description: JSONArray of wildcard match conditions. A maximum of 15 conditions is allowed.

operation.description: Match operation evaluated against the column value.

value.description: Pattern the column value is matched against.

FilterAdditionalDetails.title: FilterAdditionalDetails
FilterAdditionalDetails.description: JSONObject carrying extra context about where the filter originated.

isFromDashboard.description: Indicates whether the filter was pushed down from a dashboard.

fromViewId.description: ID of the dashboard or view the filter originated from.

UserFilters.title: UserFilters
UserFilters.description: JSONArray of interactive filter widgets shown to the viewer inside the view. Maximum serialized size 1 MB.

UserFilter.title: UserFilter
UserFilter.description: One interactive filter widget displayed to the viewer of the analysis view.

tableName.description: Name of the table the filter column belongs to.

columnName.description: Name of the column the widget filters on.

operation.description: Aggregation or grouping applied to the column before filtering.

compType.description: Type of widget presented to the viewer.

filterType.description:
Category of filter applied to the column.

- **value** - Matches the exact values listed in `values`.
- **ranking** - Top or bottom N, expressed as a string such as `Top 5` in `values`.
- **wildcard** - Pattern match driven by the `wildcard` attribute.
- **individualValues** - Discrete value picker used by interactive user filters.
- **year**, **quarter**, **month**, **week**, **weekday** - Date part groupings.
- **fulldate**, **date**, **datetime** - Absolute date or date-time matching.
- **quarteryear**, **weekyear** - Combined date part groupings.
- **common** - Relative period such as a rolling window.
- **range** - Bounded range between two values.

isallval.description: Controls whether every value in the widget is selected initially.

exclude.description: Controls whether the selected values are excluded instead of included.

behaviour.description: Controls which values populate the widget's list.

DefaultFilterValues.title: DefaultFilterValues
DefaultFilterValues.description: JSONArray of values the widget falls back to when the viewer clears the selection.

ViewSettings.title: ViewSettings
ViewSettings.description: JSONObject holding the layout and theme settings of the view. Maximum serialized size 10 KB.

ViewSettingsLayout.title: ViewSettingsLayout
ViewSettingsLayout.description: JSONObject controlling the column layout of the view.

defaultWidth.description: Default column width in pixels, applied to pivot and summary tables.

ViewSettingsThemes.title: ViewSettingsThemes
ViewSettingsThemes.description: JSONObject controlling the visual theme of the view.

themeType.description: Index of the preset theme style applied to the view.

themeColor.description: Primary accent color of the theme, as a hex code.

themeFontSize.description: Base font size of the view in points.

compactIndent.description: Row indentation depth applied in compact mode.

fontColor.description: Override for the font color, as a hex code.

DrillActionConfig.title: DrillActionConfig
DrillActionConfig.description: JSONObject configuring the actions triggered when a viewer clicks a data point. Maximum serialized size 100 KB.

DrillActions.title: DrillActions
DrillActions.description: JSONArray of drill action items. A maximum of 10 actions is allowed.

DrillAction.title: DrillAction
DrillAction.description: One drill-through action invoked from a data point in the view.

id.description: Unique identifier of the action, as a long integer or a hyphenated long-integer string.

urlString.description: Target URL invoked when the action fires.

methodType.description: HTTP method used to call the target URL.

body.description: Raw request body sent with the action.

DrillActionKeyValues.title: DrillActionKeyValues
DrillActionKeyValues.description: JSONArray of key-value entries used for the headers, query parameters or form body of a drill action. Maximum serialized size 5 KB.

DrillActionKeyValue.title: DrillActionKeyValue
DrillActionKeyValue.description: One key-value entry of a drill action.

value.description: Value of the entry. Column placeholders in the format {{ColumnName}} are substituted at click time.

type.description: Whether the value is a literal or resolved from the clicked data point.

ModifiedPaths.title: ModifiedPaths
ModifiedPaths.description: JSONObject with the configuration path as key and the change marker as value, used to signal which parts of the configuration were touched. Maximum serialized size 10 KB.

<config_path>.description: Marker for the change applied at that path. NOTE: the key should be a path within the report configuration.

CreateReportConfig.title: CreateReportConfig
CreateReportConfig.description: Configuration of the analysis view to be created. `chartType`, `isAxisMerge` and `mergeAxisInfo` apply only when `reportType` is chart.

baseTableName.description: Display name of the base table the analysis view is created on.

reportType.description: The type of analysis view to create.

title.description: Display name of the new view. If it is omitted, the view ID is used as the title. Must be unique within the workspace.

examples: Bar chart filtered to the top 5 products by average cost

folderId.description: ID of the folder the new view is placed in. Send -1 to place it in the root folder. If it is omitted, the root folder is used.

chartType.description: Chart sub-type of the view. Mandatory when `reportType` is chart, ignored otherwise.

isAxisMerge.description: Controls whether multiple y-axes are merged onto a single scale. Applicable only to chart views, and requires `mergeAxisInfo`.

UpdateReportConfig.title: UpdateReportConfig
UpdateReportConfig.description: Replacement configuration for an existing analysis view. This is a full reset rather than a patch - every axis column, filter, user filter and settings entry is replaced with what is sent, and anything omitted reverts to its empty default. `description` is cleared if it is left out. `title`, `folderId` and `baseTableName` cannot be changed here, and `reportType` must match the existing view type.

objId.description: ID of the view to update. If it is omitted, the view ID from the URL path is used.

reportType.description: Type of the analysis view. Must match the existing view type; it cannot be changed through this API.

description.description: Updated description of the view. If it is omitted, the existing description is cleared.

chartType.description: Chart sub-type of the view. Mandatory when `reportType` is chart, ignored otherwise.

isAxisMerge.description: Controls whether multiple y-axes are merged onto a single scale. Applicable only to chart views, and requires `mergeAxisInfo`.

CreateReportResponse.title: CreateReportResponse
CreateReportResponse.description: Response returned when an analysis view is created.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

CreateReportResponseData.title: CreateReportResponseData
CreateReportResponseData.description: Identifiers of the newly created analysis view.

viewId.description: ID of the newly created analysis view. Use it in the URL of later Update Analysis View and Get Report Metadata calls.

GetReportMetadataResponse.title: GetReportMetadataResponse
GetReportMetadataResponse.description: Response carrying the stored configuration of an analysis view.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetReportMetadataResponseData.title: GetReportMetadataResponseData
GetReportMetadataResponseData.description: Wrapper holding the stored view configuration.

ReportConfigMetadata.title: ReportConfigMetadata
ReportConfigMetadata.description: The full configuration of the analysis view as stored. It is structurally identical to the Create Analysis View CONFIG, so it can be used directly as the base for a clone or an update.

description.description: Description of the view. Omitted when it is empty.

chartType.description: Chart sub-type of the view. Present for chart views.

baseTableName.description: Name of the base table the view is built on.

isAxisMerge.description: Indicates whether multiple y-axes are merged onto a single scale.

ReportMetadataAxisColumns.title: ReportMetadataAxisColumns
ReportMetadataAxisColumns.description: JSONArray of the axis columns stored for the view. The axis `type` values are returned in lowercase, which are the canonical forms - copy them verbatim when building a Create or Update CONFIG from this response.

ReportMetadataAxisColumn.title: ReportMetadataAxisColumn
ReportMetadataAxisColumn.description: One axis column as stored for the view. Identical in shape to AxisColumn, except that the axis `type` is returned in lowercase.

type.description: Axis role this column plays in the view, in the canonical lowercase form.

tableName.description: Name of the table the column belongs to.

displayName.description: Custom label shown on the axis.

operation.description: Aggregation or date grouping applied to the column.

geoRole.description: Geographic role of the column. Present when `operation` is geo.

DashboardSummary.title: DashboardSummary
DashboardSummary.description: Summary of one dashboard as returned by the listing APIs.

viewId.description: ID of the dashboard. Returned as a string even though the underlying value is a long integer.

viewDesc.description: Description of the dashboard. An empty string when none is set.
examples: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

viewType.description: Type of the view. Always Dashboard for entries returned by these APIs.

parentViewId.description: ID of the parent view, if there is one. An empty string otherwise.

folderId.description: ID of the folder that contains the dashboard.

createdTime.description: Creation timestamp of the dashboard, in epoch milliseconds.

createdBy.description: Email address of the user who created the dashboard.

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of the last modification, in epoch milliseconds.

lastModifiedBy.description: Email address of the user who last modified the dashboard.

isFavorite.description: Indicates whether the requesting user has marked the dashboard as a favorite.

sharedBy.description: Email address of the user who shared the dashboard. Populated for shared entries and an empty string for owned entries.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace that contains the dashboard. Use it as the workspace ID in the workspace-scoped dashboard APIs.

orgId.description: ID of the organization the workspace belongs to. It corresponds to the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header value.

GetDashboardsResponse.title: GetDashboardsResponse
GetDashboardsResponse.description: Response listing every dashboard accessible to the authenticated user, split into owned and shared.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetDashboardsResponseData.title: GetDashboardsResponseData
GetDashboardsResponseData.description: The two dashboard lists returned by Get All Dashboards.

GetDashboardListResponse.title: GetDashboardListResponse
GetDashboardListResponse.description: Response carrying a single list of dashboards - owned only or shared only, depending on the endpoint.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetDashboardListResponseData.title: GetDashboardListResponseData
GetDashboardListResponseData.description: The dashboard list returned by Get Owned Dashboards and Get Shared Dashboards.

DashboardLayout.title: DashboardLayout
DashboardLayout.description: JSONObject with the card index as key and the card definition as value. Keys are sequential index strings starting at "1". The map is a complete replacement of the dashboard layout - any card that is not present is removed.

DashboardLayoutCard.title: DashboardLayoutCard
DashboardLayoutCard.description: One card placed on the dashboard grid. NOTE: the key of this entry in `layout` should be the card's sequential index as a string.

type.description: Type of content the card renders.

width.description: Width of the card in grid units. Combined with `left`, it must not exceed 80.

height.description: Height of the card in grid units. The minimum varies by card type - 3 for USERFILTERS and 5 for HTML.

left.description: Left offset of the card in grid units.

top.description: Top offset of the card in grid units.

viewName.description: Display name of the existing analysis view embedded in the card. Mandatory when `type` is VIEW. The view is identified by name, not by ID.

content.description: HTML markup, image URL or embed URL, depending on the card type. Mandatory when `type` is HTML, IMAGE, EMBED, TITLE or PARA.

DashboardCardProperties.title: DashboardCardProperties
DashboardCardProperties.description: JSONObject with the property name as key and the property value as value, carrying additional card level properties such as interaction overrides.

<property_name>.description: Value of that card property. NOTE: the key should be a card property name supported for the card type.

DashboardThemes.title: DashboardThemes
DashboardThemes.description: JSONObject holding the visual theme of the dashboard. Sending `default` as "true" resets the theme and causes every other attribute here to be ignored.

default.description: Resets the theme to the built-in defaults. When it is "true", all other theme attributes are ignored.

type.description: Background fill style of the dashboard.

layoutType.description: Number of the preset layout theme.

DashboardThemeSolid.title: DashboardThemeSolid
DashboardThemeSolid.description: JSONObject configuring a solid background, applied when the theme `type` is solid.

background.description: Background color of the dashboard, as a hex code.

DashboardThemeGradient.title: DashboardThemeGradient
DashboardThemeGradient.description: JSONObject configuring a gradient background, applied when the theme `type` is gradient.

background.description: Fallback background color, as a hex code.

startColor.description: Color the gradient starts from, as a hex code.

endColor.description: Color the gradient ends at, as a hex code.

DashboardGradientLinear.title: DashboardGradientLinear
DashboardGradientLinear.description: JSONObject configuring a linear gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is linear.

angle.description: Angle of the linear gradient, in degrees.

DashboardGradientRadial.title: DashboardGradientRadial
DashboardGradientRadial.description: JSONObject configuring a radial gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is radial.

x.description: Horizontal focal point of the radial gradient.

y.description: Vertical focal point of the radial gradient.

DashboardThemeImage.title: DashboardThemeImage
DashboardThemeImage.description: JSONObject configuring an image background, applied when the theme `type` is image.

background.description: Fallback color rendered behind the image, as a hex code.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment applied to the image.

contrast.description: Contrast adjustment applied to the image.

transparency.description: Transparency of the image as a percentage, sent as a string between "0" and "100".

flip.description: Controls whether the image is flipped.

fitType.description: Strategy used to fit the image to the dashboard.

color.description: Font color, as a hex code.

DashboardThemeCard.title: DashboardThemeCard
DashboardThemeCard.description: JSONObject controlling the styling applied to every card on the dashboard.

background.description: Background color of the card, as a hex code.

blur.description: Blur radius applied behind the card.

shadow.description: Shadow style applied to the card.

paletteType.description: Palette variant used by the card.

DashboardCardBorder.title: DashboardCardBorder
DashboardCardBorder.description: JSONObject describing the border of a dashboard card.

color.description: Border color, as a hex code.

width.description: Border width, sent as a string between "0" and "5".

DashboardCardTextStyle.title: DashboardCardTextStyle
DashboardCardTextStyle.description: JSONObject styling the title or the description text of a dashboard card.

DashboardChartEffect.title: DashboardChartEffect
DashboardChartEffect.description: JSONObject controlling the animation effect applied to the charts on the dashboard.

apply.description: Controls whether a chart effect is applied. Mandatory whenever `chartEffect` is sent.

DashboardPalette.title: DashboardPalette
DashboardPalette.description: JSONObject holding the color palette applied to the charts on the dashboard.

DashboardPaletteChart.title: DashboardPaletteChart
DashboardPaletteChart.description: JSONObject naming the chart color palette.

type.description: Name of the chart color palette.

DashboardSettings.title: DashboardSettings
DashboardSettings.description: JSONObject holding the behaviour settings of the dashboard. Every attribute is sent as a string. On Update Dashboard the whole object replaces the stored settings, so any attribute that is omitted reverts to its system default.

enableGlobalUF.description: Controls whether a global user filter is applied across all cards.

enableGlobalValueUF.description: Controls whether the global value based user filter is enabled.

smartAlignCharts.description: Controls whether charts are auto-aligned to the grid.

showContextualOptions.description: Controls whether contextual chart options are shown to viewers.

allowEmbedInsights.description: Controls whether AI insights can be embedded in the dashboard.

enableSortMenu.description: Controls whether sort options are shown in viewer mode.

reportAsFilter.description: Controls whether charts can act as filters for the other charts on the dashboard.

hideColumnOptions.description: Controls whether column level options are hidden in viewer mode.

allowVUD.description: Controls whether view, update and delete interactions are allowed.

allowInsights.description: Controls whether AI powered insights are enabled.

fitToWidth.description: Controls whether the dashboard is stretched to fill the browser width.

layoutType.description: Width mode used to lay the dashboard out.

layoutWidth.description: Custom layout width in pixels. It applies only when `layoutType` is custom_width.

allowDrillDown.description: Controls whether drill-down on chart data points is enabled.

applyImmediateUF.description: Controls whether user filter values are applied immediately, without a submit button.

timeSlicer.description: Controls whether the time-slicer user filter component is enabled.

mapSync.description: Controls whether the map view is synchronized across the dashboard cards.

DashboardAllowExport.title: DashboardAllowExport
DashboardAllowExport.description: JSONObject controlling which export formats viewers are allowed to use. Every attribute is sent as a string and defaults to "true".

csv.description: Controls whether CSV export is allowed.

excel.description: Controls whether Excel export is allowed.

html.description: Controls whether HTML export is allowed.

image.description: Controls whether image export is allowed.

pdf.description: Controls whether PDF export is allowed.

zohoSheet.description: Controls whether export to Zoho Sheet is allowed.

CreateDashboardConfig.title: CreateDashboardConfig
CreateDashboardConfig.description: Configuration of the dashboard to be created.

displayName.description: Display name of the new dashboard. Must be unique within the workspace.

layoutType.description: Grid column preset applied at creation time. When a preset between 1 and 4 is used, the server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at index "1" and rearranges the view cards into columns, so the card indices that were sent may be renumbered.

UpdateDashboardConfig.title: UpdateDashboardConfig
UpdateDashboardConfig.description: Replacement configuration for an existing dashboard. Every attribute is optional and only the sections that are sent are touched, but a section that is sent replaces the stored one wholesale rather than merging into it. `displayName` and `description` cannot be changed through this API.

layoutType.description: Grid column preset applied to the dashboard. When a preset between 1 and 4 is used, the server auto-injects a USERFILTERS card at index "1" and rearranges the view cards into columns.

GetDashboardMetadataConfig.title: GetDashboardMetadataConfig
GetDashboardMetadataConfig.description: Configuration controlling which sections of the dashboard are returned.

include.description:
Sections of the dashboard configuration to include in the response. Several sections can be requested as a comma separated list, for example `themes,layout`.

- **all** - Returns objId, displayName, description, themes, layout and settings.
- **themes** - Returns only the theme configuration.
- **layout** - Returns only the layout card map.
- **settings** - Returns only the behaviour settings.

> **Note:** When a specific section is requested, the objId, displayName and description identity fields are not returned.

CreateDashboardResponse.title: CreateDashboardResponse
CreateDashboardResponse.description: Response returned when a dashboard is created.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

CreateDashboardResponseData.title: CreateDashboardResponseData
CreateDashboardResponseData.description: Identifiers of the newly created dashboard.

dashboardId.description: ID of the newly created dashboard. It is the same value returned as objId by Get Dashboard Metadata and as viewId by the listing APIs.

displayName.description: Display name of the newly created dashboard, as stored.

GetDashboardMetadataResponse.title: GetDashboardMetadataResponse
GetDashboardMetadataResponse.description: Response carrying the stored configuration of a dashboard.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetDashboardMetadataResponseData.title: GetDashboardMetadataResponseData
GetDashboardMetadataResponseData.description: Wrapper holding the stored dashboard configuration.

DashboardConfigMetadata.title: DashboardConfigMetadata
DashboardConfigMetadata.description: The full configuration of the dashboard as stored. Sections that were never customized are omitted, and the identity attributes are returned only when `include` is all or CONFIG is omitted. Theme and settings scalars are serialized as strings even where the CONFIG accepts numbers - a `layoutType` sent as 6 comes back as "6", and a card `opacity` sent as 0.2 comes back as "0.2". Only the layout card geometry is returned as numbers.

objId.description: ID of the dashboard. It can be used directly as the dashboard ID in the Update Dashboard URL.

description.description: Description of the dashboard. An empty string when none is set.

DashboardThemesMetadata.title: DashboardThemesMetadata
DashboardThemesMetadata.description: JSONObject holding the visual theme of the dashboard. Sending `default` as "true" resets the theme and causes every other attribute here to be ignored. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

default.description: Resets the theme to the built-in defaults. When it is "true", all other theme attributes are ignored.

type.description: Background fill style of the dashboard.

layoutType.description: Number of the preset layout theme. Returned as a string between "1" and "6".

DashboardThemeGradientMetadata.title: DashboardThemeGradientMetadata
DashboardThemeGradientMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a gradient background, applied when the theme `type` is gradient. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Fallback background color, as a hex code.

startColor.description: Color the gradient starts from, as a hex code.

endColor.description: Color the gradient ends at, as a hex code.

DashboardGradientLinearMetadata.title: DashboardGradientLinearMetadata
DashboardGradientLinearMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a linear gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is linear. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

angle.description: Angle of the linear gradient, in degrees. Returned as a string between "-270" and "270".

DashboardGradientRadialMetadata.title: DashboardGradientRadialMetadata
DashboardGradientRadialMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a radial gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is radial. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

x.description: Horizontal focal point of the radial gradient. Returned as a string between "0" and "180".

y.description: Vertical focal point of the radial gradient. Returned as a string between "0" and "180".

DashboardThemeImageMetadata.title: DashboardThemeImageMetadata
DashboardThemeImageMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring an image background, applied when the theme `type` is image. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Fallback color rendered behind the image, as a hex code.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment applied to the image. Returned as a string between "-100" and "100".

contrast.description: Contrast adjustment applied to the image. Returned as a string between "-100" and "100".

transparency.description: Transparency of the image as a percentage, sent as a string between "0" and "100".

flip.description: Controls whether the image is flipped.

fitType.description: Strategy used to fit the image to the dashboard.

DashboardFontMetadata.title: DashboardFontMetadata
DashboardFontMetadata.description: JSONObject describing a font configuration. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

color.description: Font color, as a hex code.

size.description: Font size in points. Returned as a string between "7" and "24".

DashboardThemeCardMetadata.title: DashboardThemeCardMetadata
DashboardThemeCardMetadata.description: JSONObject controlling the styling applied to every card on the dashboard. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Background color of the card, as a hex code.

opacity.description: Opacity of the card background. Returned as a string between "0" and "1".

blur.description: Blur radius applied behind the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "50".

radius.description: Corner radius of the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "20".

margin.description: Outer margin of the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "10".

shadow.description: Shadow style applied to the card. Returned as a string.

paletteType.description: Palette variant used by the card. Returned as a string.

DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata.title: DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata
DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata.description: JSONObject styling the title or the description text of a dashboard card. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

DashboardChartEffectMetadata.title: DashboardChartEffectMetadata
DashboardChartEffectMetadata.description: JSONObject controlling the animation effect applied to the charts on the dashboard. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

apply.description: Controls whether a chart effect is applied. Mandatory whenever `chartEffect` is sent. Returned as a string.

type.description: Effect variant applied when `apply` is 2. Returned as a string.
